dialogueLines.line: Like, another Prisma? Which dimension are you from?

dialogueLines.line: Zoinks! You look familiar but different.

dialogueLines.line: Like, are you the evil twin or the good twin?

dialogueLines.line: I can't tell you two apart, man.
